stylesheets.description: Extra author stylesheets, applied after the document's own.

data.description: Contract 1.1. With data, document is a MiniJinja HTML template expanded with this JSON before render.

schema.description: Contract 1.1. JSON Schema for data. Default: a path template's sibling <name>.schema.json. Requires data.

mode.description: path: local only. bytes: base64 in the result. link: cloud download URL (local MAY support it with a file:// URL). auto: local = bytes, cloud = link.

path.description: Required when mode is path. Local only.
